name: Anna Paulina Luna
summary: A Republican who calls herself MAGA, she is strongly anti-abortion, pro-gun, hawkish on China and the military, and favors tough border enforcement and an immigration pause. She opposes further Ukraine aid and US NATO membership but defended the 2026 strikes on Iran, and campaigns on government transparency, UAP and JFK disclosure, congressional term limits and a ban on stock trading.

sources.title: Anna Paulina Luna: career and political positions
sources.author: Wikipedia contributors
sources.usedFor: Full relevant sections in wiki-current.json, wiki-find.json and wiki-citations.json; reference context and personally initiated monument proposal.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Answered that government must not ensure everyone has health insurance, strongly opposed eliminating private insurance, and favors free-market, patient-centered reform; in 2022 opposed expanding ObamaCare.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Strongly agreed that free enterprise is essential and strongly opposed economic stimulus; the claim about markets versus governments is broader than what she addressed.

property-fundamental.rationale: Strongly agreed that free enterprise and private property are essential; she has also backed limits on Chinese-government land purchases near bases, so 'very hard to override' is not fully shown.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Mixed: she said environmental regulations cost jobs and favored breaking up big tech and rewriting FCC rules for social media, and cosponsored a 10% credit-card interest cap with a Democrat.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Said she voted against FISA reauthorization and called the way it can surveil Americans 'freaky'.

legalize-drugs.rationale: In 2020 she disagreed with legalizing recreational marijuana; her answer concerned marijuana, not drugs in general.

limit-guns.rationale: Describes herself as pro-gun, answered 'no restrictions on gun ownership' and strongly favors an absolute right to gun ownership.

empower-police-military.rationale: Strongly agreed with peace through a strong military, strongly favored military expansion, supports qualified immunity and opposes redirecting police funds.

rehabilitation.rationale: Mixed: strongly favored stricter punishment and mandatory minimums for violent crime, but later spoke of prison reform in a TV appearance.

traditional-family.rationale: Strongly agreed that marriage is between one man and one woman and that Judeo-Christian values underpin limited government.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: In her 2020 questionnaire she strongly agreed with defining marriage as one man and one woman; no later statement was found.

abortion-legal.rationale: Allows no exceptions to abortion ('Abortion should be allowed under: None') and calls herself pro-life.

more-religion-public.rationale: Strongly agreed religious liberty deserves the highest legal protection and favored keeping God in the public sphere.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Opposed critical race theory and race-based reparations; also said 'Racism is wrong', so the evidence is partial.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Said the system is broken and the fix is a temporary pause in the immigration process so legal applicants can catch up.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Said she wants standalone bills to defund the UN Human Rights Council so money goes only to legitimate causes; has expressed opposition to US NATO membership.

nation-first.rationale: Focus on 'our own sovereignty' and 'American Oil from American Soil'; opposes foreign entanglements in her survey answers.

open-borders.rationale: Strongly supports a border wall, said there is a reason we have borders and that people must be screened.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Supports fracking and 'American Oil from American Soil'; strongly opposes prioritizing green energy.

basic-income.rationale: Disagreed that government must ensure a livable income; the statement about an unconditional basic income was not put to her.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Said she agrees with the recently announced reciprocal tariffs and trusts the president's handling of the economy; framed them as pressuring other countries to drop their own tariffs.

separate-church-state.rationale: Said the state should not interfere in the business of the church while favoring God in public life; she did not call for strict separation.

military-superiority.rationale: Strongly agreed with peace through a strong military and strongly favored American exceptionalism and military expansion.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Said AI could be used for decision-making only with a human as the final authority, and answered 'I don't know about that' when a host joked that AI should take over.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Strongly opposed stimulus in favor of market recovery and voted against the 2023 Fiscal Responsibility Act; wants to cut waste and subsidy spending.

force-without-un.rationale: Defended the 2026 strikes on Iran as within the president's Article II authority, without referring to UN Security Council approval.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Describes herself as a born-again Christian and said leaders should look to God for divine inspiration in life decisions.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Said the idea of being an elected representative has become corrupted by special-interest lobbying, that members trade on inside information and that the institution protects itself.

term-limits.rationale: Started a discharge petition to force a House vote on congressional term limits.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Has said she opposes US membership of NATO and voted to withdraw troops from Syria and Somalia; her own words on ending alliances generally were not found.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Strongly agreed with peace through a strong military and favored military expansion.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Opposes redirecting police funds, supports qualified immunity and favored stricter punishment.

close-ties-china.rationale: Said the biggest threat facing the country is China and has repeatedly described the Chinese government as seeking to undermine the US.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Strongly opposed legally requiring the hiring of women and minorities and opposed critical race theory.

public-access-to-information.rationale: Leads a congressional task force pushing declassification, saying the public should see federal records on UAPs, JFK, Epstein and similar subjects.

corporate-influence.rationale: Agreed lobbying is a dirty game, objected to special-interest lobbying and former members moving into lobbying, and favors banning stock trading.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Called for freezing the assets of a foreign-linked donor and for disclosure of influencers' foreign funding; said foreign governments use free speech against the US.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Said she does not agree with gender-affirming care but adults are free to do it, and supports restrictions for minors; she did not address legal recognition directly.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Strongly favors an absolute right to gun ownership and says she is pro-gun, which conflicts with confining arms to the state.

voter-id.rationale: Said voter ID should be mandatory.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Strongly agreed with mandatory minimums for violent crimes.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Mixed: she has said student loan forgiveness is not fair, but supports relief for borrowers through statutory caps on student-loan interest.

cut-welfare.rationale: She describes government dependency as trapping poor communities and calls for reform.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Her letter says the state may punish offenders but not thoughts or opinions.

decide-locally.rationale: Her signed letter defends state agricultural choices against sweeping federal preemption.

expand-nuclear.rationale: She voted for the Atomic Energy Advancement Act to advance nuclear deployment.

widespread-small-property.rationale: She favors household homeownership over corporate accumulation of single-family homes.

ban-interest.rationale: She supports capped credit-card interest, rather than prohibiting interest altogether.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: She demands equal legal accountability and government contracting without skin-color discrimination.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: She objects to global governance that would subordinate the American republic.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: She strongly opposes abolishing the Electoral College.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: She rejects state interference or tax pressure restricting churches.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: She insists elected officials must obey the same laws as every American.

leader-cult.rationale: She personally introduced a bill adding Trump’s face to Mount Rushmore.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: She introduces protections against wild-horse slaughter and promotes adoption for humane care.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Her letter supports continued pork production alongside state crate-free welfare standards.

non-intervention.rationale: She threatens US travel sanctions against foreign legislators supporting an AfD ban.

suppress-opposition.rationale: She opposes eliminating unwelcome competitors through politically instrumentalized intelligence assessments.

cut-consumption-tax.rationale: She favors temporarily suspending the federal gasoline excise tax.

no-business-privileges.rationale: She rejects corporate immunity and lobbying that prevents accountability for harmful products.

notes:
Marriage and abortion answers come from her 2020 questionnaire; no later statement found. Interview transcripts are YouTube auto-captions. She has said she is both 'MAGA' and willing to break with leadership (proxy voting for new parents, stock-trading ban, FISA vote, Epstein files), so party loyalty alone was not used to answer anything.

Merged with an independent gpt-6.1-sol audit: 18 answers taken from it, 18 agreed, 1 conflicts settled by the integrator.

gpt-6.1-sol notes: Independent pass; previous answers not consulted. One priority answered, equal legal worth; no living-person inference. Every active statement and all nulls reviewed. Candidate questionnaire answers are distinguished from quiz-site ideological guesses. Marriage-belief exemptions do not establish opposition to civil same-sex marriage. Cannabis opposition does not answer all recreational drugs. Opposition to unauthorized immigration does not establish lower overall immigration. Her mixed ancestry and outreach work establish neither anti-miscegenation policy nor ethnic political organization. The CNN race breakdown describes polling, not a racial franchise rule. Racial-contracting neutrality and common legal accountability support qualified equality, not an inferred theory of biological racial ability. AfD advocacy is not evidence of every AfD position, unconditional democracy or a general ban on genuinely anticonstitutional parties. Her own election-fraud claims are documented reference context, not proof the election was stolen. Warrant protections do not establish unbreakable encryption or constitution-amendment entrenchment. AI safety comments lack an explicit extinction priority, wholesale algorithmic government or acceleration despite disruption; the other panelists’ arguments are excluded. Government dependency criticism coexists with targeted consumer regulation; specific protections are scored without attributing a comprehensive economic doctrine. Tort rights coexist with EPA oversight, leaving the tort-instead-of-agencies statement null. Oil policy does not establish rejection of all climate action; tourism-oriented coastal preservation does not establish intrinsic nature value. The Iran interview defends a preventive strike, based on her claimed expected attack, but does not state a categorical rule about all defensive wars or UN authorization. She does not answer the repeated-flood bailout question. Convention common-good language concerns private financial interest, not overriding individual rights. No government-success claims are accepted solely from campaign assertions.
